messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "sprinkle the medicine into a spoonful of applesauce"
set: ["sprinkle the medicine into a spoonful of applesauce", "sprinkle the contents onto a tablespoon of applesauce", "medicine may be sprinkled into small amount of applesauce", "do not sprinkle contents on foods other than applesauce", "you can sprinkle the contents over a teaspoon of soft food", "if you cannot swallow a capsule whole, open it and mix the medicine with applesauce", "do not transfer the insulin from the pen into a syringe", "instead, a different form of the medicine should be used", "another person may inject into the back of the upper arm", "do not transfer leftover medicine into syringe", "injected into a vein by a healthcare provider", "inject into the abdomen or thigh", "do not inject into the same place twice in a row", "never crush or break a tramadol tablet to inhale the powder or mix it into a liquid to inject the drug into your vein", "applesauce should not be warm", "you may mix the concentrated solution with juice or a soft food such as applesauce"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
